    ABOUT TX RATEV3.0

    This app can inspect image properties and map facial landmarks. It cannot scientifically determine a person's attractiveness, assign PSL scores, or classify people as Sub3, LTN, MTN, HTN, Chad or similar tiers. Its suggestions focus on controllable photo conditions and personal styling choices.
